query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('grants',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',g.principal_kind,'id',g.principal_id)),'[]') FROM photo_grants g WHERE g.photo_id=p.id),'tags',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t.name),'[]') FROM photo_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.id=pt.tag_id WHERE pt.photo_id=p.id)) ORDER BY p.id),'[]') AS "state!" FROM photos p WHERE p.id=ANY($1)
